digest.component_or_area: README.md source-install documentation and pipx toolchain
propositions: pipx source install fails with error requiring uv>=0.9.17 when host uv is older (e.g., 0.7.18)
The failure is caused by a host pipx/uv toolchain mismatch, not a rebar packaging defect
Using `pipx install --backend pip` instead of the default uv backend resolves the installation failure
README.md From source section must document the observed uv>=0.9.17 error and the --backend pip workaround
